notes: The prompt self-declares Monster Tag / Hide & Seek, which is Party & Casual outright; one oversized player hunting the rest until they are tagged out is also a 1-vs-all chase, so Survival is named second without taking the shape. Childhood Game is the mode, but its space-bounded shape is replaced by space-staged because the answers ask for a small separate lobby that everyone is teleported out of when the round begins - that is what the isolated stage exists for, and it is the P4 in the route. obstacle-maze was dropped: this is dense forest cover, not a warren of rooms and corridors, so cover-los carries the mossy rocks, hollow trees, tall grass and giant furniture instead. terrain-relief holds the elevated stone platforms and vertical escape routes the scale answer calls load-bearing, and because it also asks for hidden tunnels it lands on P2 rather than plain tiered - drop the tunnels and it falls back to tiered. Decided without a user: the 3-minute timer, role assignment, fog/low-gravity/radar events and the HUD counters are gameplay and UI, so only the tag detection volumes and the spectator area are placed.
